messages.subject: Project Zephyr — Licence mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (v2, tracked). The principal points for Wexbourne:

1. Liability cap — £5m is too low for a deployment of this scale; we've moved clause 8.3 to £10m.
2. Royalty — we've reduced the rate at Schedule 3 to 4.0% and, given the cap, increased the annual royalty cap to £2.5m.
3. Exclusivity — we've extended the clause 2.2 exclusivity from three to five years to protect Wexbourne's first-mover position.

Most other points are drafting. Happy to discuss on a call this week.

Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.snippet: Marcus, Aisha, Priya, Wexbourne's mark-up is in (attached). Three commercial points to decide: - Lia
messages.subject: FW: Project Zephyr — Licence mark-up (v2) — our view
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Aisha, Priya,

Wexbourne's mark-up is in (attached). Three commercial points to decide:

- Liability cap: they want £10m (we drafted £5m). I'd suggest we land around £9m with the fee carve-outs preserved.
- Royalty: they've cut the rate to 4.0% but raised the cap to £2.5m. I'd push the rate back up to 4.5% and hold the cap at £2.0m — better for you if NBV grows.
- Exclusivity: they want five years; I'd resist and hold at three, which is what the term sheet said.

Can we grab 20 minutes tomorrow to confirm the counter? Priya — keen on your view on the royalty trade-off.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
